Fixed the reverse index range in `_token_matching` in sqlparse/sql.py. It was `range(start - 2, -2, -1)` and is now `range(start - 2, -1, -1)`, which is the upstream form. The old range also checked index -1, so backward token lookups could wrap around to the last token in the list. That is the likely cause of the strip-comments and reindent failures.

I did not run the test suite, because there is no `tests` directory in the workspace. I ran two manual checks. Stripping the comment from `select a -- c\nfrom b` gave `select a\nfrom b`. Reindenting `select a,b from t where x=1` produced the expected layout.
